parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own Pushy destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-pushy` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). On the Apprise channels the gateway composes an Apprise `pushy://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Four channels are available: the free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters (`apikey_secret`, `targets_secret`); the `gateway` and `gateway-plus` transformer channels skip Apprise and POST a native Pushy push payload directly to api.pushy.me. The `gateway` channel is free; `gateway-plus` costs $0.001 per message for extra per-enrollment destinations.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Pushy destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to Pushy API (no Apprise)

apikey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Pushy apikey

targets_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Pushy targets
